overview_description.description:
Anara helps researchers make breakthrough discoveries faster. We are a single platform to find, understand and produce research papers.

In just one year, we’ve grown to $1M ARR and 1.5M users. We’re growing 20% month-over-month and our users include teams at Stanford, GSK and Johns Hopkins.

We use language models to surface and breakdown relevant information, suggest novel connections between papers and automate rote research tasks. This free’s up headspace for higher reasoning and insight - essentially expanding the researcher’s mental RAM and letting them load larger problems into memory.

We’re starting with software to read, write and find papers, but our ultimate goal is to build the researcher of the future: a human-AI hybrid that’s an order of magnitude more effective than any single researcher.

about_short_description.short_description: Anara helps researchers understand, organize and write scientific documents

product.name: Anara AI Research Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered platform that helps researchers understand, organize, and write scientific documents by analyzing PDFs, images, audio, video, and web content with referenced responses and citation management.

product.name: Table View
product.description: A spreadsheet-like interface for organizing, sorting, filtering, and discovering scientific content across a research library, with contextual chat linked to files and folders.

product.name: Collaborative Research Workspace
product.description: Real-time collaborative editing and shared repositories for research teams, including user permission management and admin controls.

product.name: AI-Powered Writing Tools
product.description: AI-assisted writing features including citation discovery, paraphrasing, summarization, and autocomplete to support faster and well-cited document creation.

product.name: Multimedia Content Analysis
product.description: Capability to process and analyze diverse content types including PDFs, images, audio recordings, videos, and web pages with AI-driven understanding and transcription.

product.name: Source Highlighting and Referenced Responses
product.description: AI responses linked directly to specific source sections with clickable citations to verify accuracy and maintain academic rigor.
